name: CanonicalWireframe NodeTypes
purpose: Declare which NodeTypes exist and which semantic sections each NodeType makes available for projection and presentation. NodeTypes do not define how sections are interpreted or rendered.

authority.nodetypes: Declare NodeType identity, inheritance and available semantic sections.
authority.rulesets: Define how Node roots, sections, Properties, Links, Functions, Events, Required Links and other semantics are read and validated.
authority.renderer: Chooses how the available canonical content is presented. Rendering is not NodeType authority.

rules: NodeTypes define what NodeTypes exist and what canonical semantic sections are available to present.

NodeTypes MUST NOT define Property value semantics, Link semantics, Function logic, Event semantics, causality, Required Link satisfaction, rendering, layout, geometry, animation, color or interaction behavior.
Every section id declared by a NodeType is interpreted only by the selected Rulesets artifact through RULESET_NODE.section_readers.
NodeType inheritance composes available sections. A child receives all parent sections and may add more.
Section order is presentation-neutral canonical metadata and MUST NOT be used as semantic execution order.
A renderer such as Structure may choose any presentation for the declared sections without changing canonical truth.
Every canonical Node has a StructureTree navigation address under the selected topology. The address is navigation topology, not semantic inference authority.
Canonical Links provide relational navigation between the same canonical Nodes. Link navigation does not create duplicate truth.
FILE, ABS, DOC and CTRCT are canonical identity families. Their NodeTypes are code, abs, doc and contract respectively.
Identity-family prefixes, filenames, extensions, directories and StructureTree paths MUST NOT be used to infer a missing NodeType.

semantics.id: Local NodeType identity inside the pinned immutable specification closure.
semantics.name: Human-readable NodeType name.
semantics.sections: Semantic section ids available on this NodeType. Section interpretation belongs exclusively to RULESET_NODE.section_readers.
semantics.extends: Optional NodeType inheritance used only to compose NodeType availability declarations.
semantics.abstract: When true, the NodeType is an inheritance/grouping type and is not intended as a concrete imported Node.
semantics.identity_family: Optional canonical identity-family convention associated with this NodeType. It does not infer type from an id prefix.

nodetypes.name: Topology Entity
nodetypes.description: Shared topology grouping type. It contributes only generic Link availability.

nodetypes.name: Code
nodetypes.description: Canonical implementation Node. Functions, Events and Required Links are part of the Code Node surface even when their projected arrays are empty.

nodetypes.name: Abstraction
nodetypes.description: Canonical abstraction Node over canonical identities. It has no Function or Event section.

nodetypes.name: Document
nodetypes.description: Canonical document Node. Its readable physical representation is exposed through the representation section; it has no Function or Event section.

nodetypes.name: Contract
nodetypes.description: Canonical contract Node. Contract relations are canonical Links; it has no Function or Event section.

structuretree.principle: StructureTree is hierarchical navigation over canonical Nodes, not a second semantic authority.
structuretree.address_source: explicit canonical Node identity plus selected topology mapping

resolution.rule: Entity.entity_type_ref resolves a NodeType only inside the NodeTypes registry selected by the active immutable specification set.
